body: Around 520 million children — roughly one in five worldwide — now live in areas affected by conflict.
全球约有5.2亿儿童（差不多每五个孩子就有一个）生活在受冲突影响的地区。
In this episode, a journalist describes meeting young people whose schooling, family life and sense of safety have been torn apart by war.
本期节目里，一位记者讲述了她见过的年轻人——他们的学业、家庭和安危都被战争摧毁了。
The hosts discuss how listening to children's own stories can help us understand trauma and the long road to recovery.
主持人探讨了：倾听孩子自己的经历，能帮我们理解创伤，以及漫长的重建之路。

articles.zh: 足球运动员的大脑里装着什么？
body: Modern football is faster than ever, so top clubs now study neuroscience to understand how players think and decide in a split second.
现代足球比以往更快，顶尖俱乐部开始研究神经科学，想弄懂球员如何在瞬间思考、做决定。
The episode looks at how training the brain — not just the body — may give athletes an edge under pressure.
本期关注：训练大脑（而不只是身体），或许能让运动员在压力下占得先机。
Listeners learn vocabulary about decision-making, reaction time and the mental side of sport.
听众能学到关于决策、反应速度和竞技心理侧的词汇。
For many families, cooking and eating together feels like one more chore instead of a joy.
对很多家庭来说，一起做饭吃饭不再是享受，反而像又一项家务。
This episode shares simple ideas for lowering the pressure — like sharing tasks and dropping the need for a perfect plate.
本期分享了一些减压小点子：比如分摊任务、别追求'完美的一餐'。
The hosts suggest that relaxed mealtimes can be better for family relationships than fancy food.
主持人认为，轻松的用餐氛围比精致大餐更利于家庭关系。
Children today spend more hours than ever in front of screens, and many parents worry about the effects.
如今的孩子花在屏幕前的时间比以往都多，许多家长为此担忧。
The episode explores practical ways families set boundaries — such as device-free dinners and agreed time limits.
本期探讨了家庭设定边界的实用方法，比如吃饭不碰设备、约定使用时长。
It also asks whether screens are all bad, since some can support learning and connection.
节目也发问：屏幕是否全无好处？有些确实能辅助学习与联结。

articles.en: How advertisers make us spend money
articles.zh: 广告是怎么让我们掏钱的
body: Advertising is everywhere, and much of it is designed to make us want things we never planned to buy.
广告无处不在，很多设计的初衷就是让我们想要原本没打算买的东西。
The episode explains tricks like limited offers, social proof and emotional storytelling used to trigger spending.
本期拆解了限时优惠、从众心理、情感故事等让人掏钱的套路。
Understanding these methods can help listeners become smarter, calmer shoppers.
看懂这些手法，能帮听众变成更清醒、更从容的消费者。
